subject: Next steps: POC success metrics, ownership & exec readout
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acmehealth.com>, David Park <david.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + proposed POC checkpoints and success metrics

Thanks for the call this morning — good to meet the team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before the POC kickoff: 

1) Primary goal (what success looks like)
- Reduce time-to-insight on clinical notes search by 60% for the pilot cohort (50k records)
- Precision >= 88% on the top-5 retrievals against your human-verified set

2) Proposed evaluation gates (owners & timing)
- Week 0 (kickoff): environment access + sample dataset (Acme) — owner: Sarah
- Week 2: baseline run + initial metric snapshot — owner: Rishi (Redwood) / Data: Acme
- Week 4: iteration + latency/cost tuning — owner: Grace (Redwood)
- Week 6: final readout + exec decision window — owner: Jordan (Redwood) / Sarah (Acme)

3) Deliverables we’ll circulate today
- Mutual action plan with dates and owners (attached: ACME-poc-mutual-action-plan.xlsx)
- Success metrics checklist (attached)
- Draft POC terms (attached)

4) Ask from Acme by EOD Wednesday
- Confirm the sample dataset deliverable (SFTP vs. GCS)
- Confirm who will be the exec reviewer for the Week 6 readout (name + preferred days/times)

If that looks right I’ll lock the calendar invites and loop in Rishi on the contract path for the go/no-go step.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: ACME-poc-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet), success-metrics-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-poc-terms.pdf (PDF)

From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acmehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: David Park <david.park@acmehealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed POC checkpoints and success metrics

Thanks Jordan — good notes. Quick clarifications before we finalize the MAP: 

- Dataset: we’ll share a de-identified 50k batch to an SFTP. Security team will provide credentials by Friday.
- Exec reviewer: David Park (CTO) — mornings are best (Tue/Thu)
- Can you confirm expected compute profile (gpus / memory) and an estimate of token costs so our finance team can pre-approve?

Also, a couple of success criteria we want to add:
- False positive rate for alarms triggered by the model must be < 12%
- Average inference latency for 512 tokens should be < 220ms (p95)

If you can fold those into the success checklist I’ll confirm the kickoff once security signs off.

—Sarah
Sarah Li
Director of Data Products | Acme Health
sarah.li@acmehealth.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acmehealth.com>, David Park <david.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 11:26:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP + compute profile + scheduling the Week 6 readout

Sarah — appreciate the quick clarifications. Attached is an updated mutual action plan and an expanded success checklist with the items you requested. Highlights: 

- Added false positive target (<12%) and p95 latency target (<220ms) to the metrics sheet.
- Compute profile (baseline): 2 x A100-80GB equiv per worker; continuous KV cache enabled; expected test run token estimate ~1.2M tokens over the POC. We’ll provide a per-token cost band once Rishi confirms pricing.
- Week 6 readout: proposed windows for David — Tue 27 Jul 08:30–09:15 PT or Thu 29 Jul 08:30–09:15 PT. Please confirm which works.

Rishi — looping you in on the pricing/contract ask below. For the readout cadence we’d like to propose a 20–30 minute exec slot that covers: quick results, cost delta, recommended next step (reserved capacity vs hosted), and contract path.

Next steps for internal owners: 
- Rishi: draft of the POC commercial note + DS to confirm per-token estimate (target by Fri EOD)
- Grace: create a tunable latency/cost playbook we can run during Week 3
- Monica: I’ll assign the calendar invites once Acme confirms the readout slot

Thanks — Jordan

Attachments: ACME-poc-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (v2), success-metrics-checklist.xlsx (v2), redwood-poc-terms.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Sarah Li <sarah.li@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated MAP + compute profile + scheduling the Week 6 readout

Thanks — quick commercial note to keep procurement moving: 

- POC commercial model: 4-week fixed-rate trial (covers compute + engineering support) with an optional 2-week extension. We can convert to a reserved capacity agreement on go/no-go.
- I’ve attached a short POC terms summary for procurement to review (redwood-poc-terms.pdf). Key ask for Acme procurement: approval of the fixed-rate POC fee and signature on the short-form SOW within two business days of go/no-go.

Jordan — I’ll post the per-token estimate by Monday once DS validates the workload profile.

Rishi
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Thanks everyone — security cleared the SFTP, we’ll send credentials tomorrow. David confirmed Tue 27 Jul 08:30–09:15 PT for the exec slot. Procurement asked for the short-form SOW and POC fee estimate prior to kickoff; Rishi, can you share the fee number this week so we can get procurement pre-cleared?

We’re aligned on the success metrics as listed in the checklist. I’ll mark owners on our side and share the dataset to the SFTP once we get the creds. Looking forward to the kickoff — please send the calendar invite for Tue 27.

—Sarah
